parameters.name: IdentifyNum
parameters.description:
ID number:

Note
Only supports the ID numbers of second-generation resident IDs and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residence permits.

- When paramType is normal: enter the plaintext ID number.

- When paramType is md5: enter the encrypted ID number.

parameters.name: Mobile
parameters.description:
Mobile phone number:

- When paramType is normal: enter the plaintext mobile phone number.

- When paramType is md5: enter the encrypted mobile phone number.

parameters.name: ParamType
parameters.description:
Encryption method:

- normal: plaintext, not encrypted

- md5: MD5 encryption

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description:
Name:

- When paramType is normal: enter the plaintext name.

- When paramType is md5: enter the encrypted name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth mobile-3-meta-simple-verify --param-type normal --identify-num '明文：429001000000008211_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --user-name '明文：张三_密文：_32fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec9' --mobile '明文：18600002055_密文：_849169cd3b20621c1c78bd61a11a4fc2' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
